rv.q: This team so beautifully capture the joy of being young and in love that it scarcely matters and the two hours fly by.
Properly hilarious production with some big laughs in one of the West End's most iconic theatres.

cn.t: A visually stunning production with fabulous sets and costumes that captures the joy of young love, though the archaic humor proves impenetrable. Despite Shakespeare's dense wordplay, the light-hearted laughs fly by entertainingly.
